name: sparx — Outdoor Essentials (Minimal)
tagline: A clean, working storefront for a design-led outdoor label.
description: A complete, working shop for a clean, design-led urban-outdoor label: a real catalogue of a packable shell, a merino tee, technical trousers, a commuter pack, a packable tote, a cap, an insulated bottle and merino socks — with categories, collections, a minimal PDP and a fully merchandised home page. Design-studio theme — a cool near-white ground, a near-black primary and a single restrained blue accent, under a crisp grotesk. Shipped as Tarn.
